$comment: Source of truth for GitHub issues. scripts/sync-issues creates missing labels and issues (matched by exact title) and writes docs/handoff/backlog.md with issue numbers. Never renumber or delete; close issues on GitHub and set state here.

labels.name: research-gap
labels.description: Evidence the corpus does not yet contain

labels.description: Lessons and process improvements from running the work

issues.title: Phase 2: run the model-council debate on the hypothesis (FR-009)
issues.body:
Run the council exactly as specified in docs/phase2/council-kit.md and handoff.md steps 1-10.

Acceptance:
- [ ] `scripts/test` green before start
- [ ] Six model families recorded in phase2/roster.md (Claude not in voting seats)
- [ ] Round 0 definitions adopted with dissent
- [ ] Rulings for D, H1-H4, H5a, H5b with scope axes, confidence and dissent
- [ ] Compound motion ruled under at least two definition sets
- [ ] phase2-council-report.md follows the output template
- [ ] Citation ledger: only [FULL]/[SECT]/[CODE] sources admitted

Refs: PRD FR-009, ADR-0004.

issues.title: Add FR-009 gate to scripts/check-research for the council report
issues.body: Extend scripts/check-research so CI fails unless phase2-council-report.md exists with the required output-template headings (roster, definitions, per-sub-claim rulings, compound motion, red team, gaps, Phase 3 implications, citation ledger), and every cited ID resolves to a [FULL]/[SECT]/[CODE] entry. Update TRD section 4 FR-009 row.

issues.title: CI reproducibility job: build reference repos and run #print axioms on headline theorems
issues.body:
All repository evidence is static inspection at recorded SHAs; nothing was built because the sandbox disk filled (decision-log #8). Review F-012 requires distinguishing static-inspected from rebuilt.

Scope: a GitHub Actions matrix over the dossiers' section 10 build commands (pinned SHAs), with Mathlib cache, a timeout, `#print axioms` on each headline theorem named in section 3, and an artefact report. Update each _index JSON `evidence_level` to `rebuilt` where it passes.

Priority targets: REF-L01 Cedar, REF-L07 SymCrypt, REF-L13 LeanMqtt, REF-L14 stdhttp-verify, REF-L21 CCF, REF-L10 VCVio, REF-L04 Veil.

issues.title: Mechanically check LeanServer axioms that appear to derive False
issues.body: REF-L14 reports, from static inspection, 5 axioms in AfonsoBitoque/LeanServer despite '0 axiom' claims. Three have the shape `forall descr : String, descr = "<const>"`, which would derive False. Confirm with `#print axioms` and a short False derivation in CI (P3-REPRO), then update REF-L14 and CONFLICTS.md.

issues.title: Phase 3: ADR-0005 toolchain decision and pilot protocol selection (FR-010)
issues.body: Contingent on the Phase 2 report. Write ADR-0005 choosing the toolchain (Lean/lake plus any extractor, or none) and the assurance level the verdict supports. Select a pilot protocol from the research/07 corpus with a rationale, and replace the research-only CI with real build and test gates. Refs: PRD FR-010, ADR-0002.

issues.title: Research gap: no formal models read for Noise, Kerberos, OAuth/OIDC, Bluetooth, EMV, BGP
issues.body: research/07 reports no formal-model sources read for these protocols, no EMV implementation, and CVE-to-scope rows for TCP/Kerberos/Bluetooth as 'none established'. 3GPP text was not read and 'IETF FMBF' was not found by name (only UFMRG). Add [FULL]/[SECT] sources or record the search as negative.

issues.title: Research gap: conformance-method sources not found (eBay trace validation, Quint/Jepsen, QuickChick, angr, Tamarin-to-code)
issues.body: research/05 could not find admissible sources for these. Mocket, SandTable, LearnLib, NEZHA, HOL-TestGen, ioco, ChatAFL and Vanhoef remain as leads. Promote them to [FULL]/[SECT] or close as not found.

issues.title: Research gap: Lean IO/Task/Async semantics and Std.Do support for concurrency and nondeterminism
issues.body: research/06 lexical search of Std/Do, Std/WP and Std/Tactic/Do found WP instances only for pure and state/exception monads, with no IO/Task/Async. This is lexical, not semantic. Needed: a primary statement from the Lean FRO or reference manual, or a small built experiment (blocked on P3-REPRO tooling). Also: no timed-system tooling found; liveness-proof evaluation for Veil is thin.

issues.title: Research gap: primary papers not obtained (Bhargavan TLS 1.3 ProVerif, Verifpal 2020, P/PObserve limitations, LeanMachines, Loom ACM, Kobeissi 'Verification Theatre' body)
issues.body: These are currently second-hand or leads only (research/01, 04, 08; REF-L06; REF-L08). Fetch the full texts (author copies, arXiv or ePrint) and convert to [FULL]/[SECT] where they bear on H2/H3.

issues.title: Research gap: live Lean Zulip search and commit-trailer analysis on full histories
issues.body: research/08 used only the public Zulip archive. Several agents used shallow clones, so AI-provenance is often `none-found` with the caveat that trailers may be hidden. Re-run provenance with blob:none full-history clones (as d1 did for Cedar, SampCert and LNSym) for every Lean dossier.

issues.title: Dossier detail gaps: SymCrypt wfPrivateSeed and SHA-3 definitions; L08 RustM WP; Fiat-Crypto admits
issues.body:
- REF-L07: `wfPrivateSeed` body and SHA-3 `absorbing`/`squeezing`/`extractOutput` are not quoted.
- REF-L08: `RustM`/Std.Do WP definition is not inspected, so the triple meaning is author-reported.
- REF-C04: whether Fiat-Crypto's 8 Admitted / 9 admit sit under the C-generation proofs is undetermined.
- REF-L07: impact of lean4#14576 on v4.31.0 is unknown.

issues.title: Strengthen thinly sourced dossiers (REF-L03, L15, L17, L19)
issues.body: scripts/check-research warns these have fewer than 3 [FULL]/[SECT]/[CODE] sources in section 14. Code-only references are legitimate, but papers, blog posts or independent reviews should be added where they exist (for example, Leslie has only its repository).

issues.title: Independent re-review: verify every REVIEW-phase1.md disposition is closed
issues.body: Dispositions for F-001 to F-013 are recorded in research/REVIEW-phase1.md. A cross-family reviewer must re-check each 'done' disposition against the final corpus and record the result. Close this issue only when every finding is verified closed or explicitly accepted as a residual risk by the owner.

issues.title: Refresh research/CASE-COMPARISON.md rows marked 'index not yet v2'
issues.body: d8 built CASE-COMPARISON.md before some _index JSONs reached schema v2 (L04-L08, L13-L16). Refresh evidence_level and ai_provenance cells from the final JSON and add rows for REF-L21, L22, L23, C10 and C11.

issues.title: Apply repository security settings (ruleset, push protection, private vulnerability reporting, CodeQL default setup)
issues.body:
Not applied: each is a separate, owner-approved remote mutation (start-github-repo hard rule).
- [ ] Ruleset on main: require PR, required status checks (CI research-gate, Security), linear history, block force pushes
- [ ] Secret scanning and push protection
- [ ] Private vulnerability reporting (SECURITY.md points to it)
- [ ] CodeQL default setup, or keep the workflow-based setup

issues.title: Review Dependabot PR #1 (GitHub Actions group bump) after CI is green on main
issues.body: PR #1 was opened against the original Node scaffold and failed the old CI. After the Phase 1 merge, rebase it (`@dependabot rebase`), confirm SHAs are full-length with version comments, run zizmor, and merge or close.

issues.title: Archive cited web sources for long-term reproducibility
issues.body: Sources move during research. For example, CCF removed its TLA+ specs on 2026-11-05 and several READMEs disagree with their code. Repos are pinned by SHA, but web pages and papers are not. Add archive links (Wayback or local text snapshots where licences allow) for every [FULL]/[SECT] web source cited by a dossier.

issues.title: Process: resource and credit budget policy for parallel research agents
issues.body:
Incidents during Phase 1b:
- Parallel Lean toolchain installs filled the 20 GB sandbox disk.
- One agent's `pkill` and another's `rm -rf /tmp/*/.lake` affected sibling agents.
- Credits ran out mid-run, and work that had not been written was lost.
- One agent made GitHub REST API calls against the rule (disclosed in research/03).

Codify in AGENTS.md and the prompts: no toolchain installs in shared sandboxes, per-agent /tmp namespaces, never kill or delete other agents' processes or files, write files incrementally, and use the build CI job (P3-REPRO) instead of local builds.

issues.title: Resolve Lean-SMT FMCAD 2026 reconstruction-count discrepancy (247 vs 348 of 403)
issues.body:
The independent review (pass 2, F-014) found the paper's internal numbers disagree. The introduction says 247/403 unsat instances are reconstructed, while Table I and §VI-B say "LEAN-SMT can solve and reconstruct 348 instances" on the same set, corroborated by Table II. Source: https://hanielbarbosa.com/papers/2026fmcad-ffproofs.pdf.

Recorded in research/06 A03 and CONFLICTS.md, unresolved. To close: check the artefact or erratum, or ask the authors, then record the answer as new evidence without rewriting the conflict. Bears on H2 (automation at scale).

issues.title: H5a coverage gap: no evidence or conflicts tagged H5a (inexpressibility blocks implementation checking)
issues.body: research/CONFLICTS.md has 0 entries tagged H5a (H1 → H3), against 13 for H5b. The review notes that methods which presuppose a Lean spec (differential testing, trace replay) cannot rebut H5a. Before the council, check the topic files and dossiers for H5a-relevant evidence: concrete protocol features that could not be expressed and thereby blocked a Lean-based check. Tag what is found, or record the negative search explicitly so the council knows the H5a evidence base is thin.

issues.title: REF-L22 Perennial/Goose: axiom dependence of netfs_crash_safety; Rocq papers unread
issues.body:
From the REF-L22 dossier:
- `netfs_crash_safety` holds conditional on `[go.Semantics]` and `[Assumptions]`. No instance of go.Semantics, PreSemantics or ArraySemantics was found statically, and ArraySemantics once proved False (fixed 2026-10-25).
- There are 3,726 axiom declaration lines. It is undetermined which ones netfs depends on; this needs `#print axioms` (issue #4).
- The Rocq Perennial papers that support crash-WP and refinement claims sit in §15 (unread), so the Lean-vs-Rocq conflict CF-120 has only one fully evidenced side.

issues.title: REF-L23 Telltale: trace whether execInstr satisfies SendSpec/RecvSpec
issues.body: Coherence preservation in Telltale requires SendSpec/RecvSpec, Coherent and SendReady. The dossier did not trace whether the scheduler's `execInstr` satisfies those specs (listed in §15). Without this, the coherence theorem's application to the runtime step is unestablished. Also confirm the n>1 threaded refinement premise `ThreadedRoundRefinementPremises` is discharged anywhere.

issues.title: REF-L04 Veil: confirm which invariant VCs are actually proved (#check_invariants skips unproved VCs)
issues.body: Static inspection found no single per-module `Invariant` theorem. The #check_invariants docstring says it emits per-VC theorems and that "VCs without a successful proof witness are skipped". SMT results are trusted by default (veil.smt.trust = true). This needs a build (issue #4) that lists the emitted theorems and their axioms for each of the 16 CAV'25 case studies.

issues.title: CF-126: obtain verbatim Aneris ESOP 2020 statement on message duplication
issues.body: In CF-126, the paper side is a paraphrase from REF-C10, not a verbatim quote. Read the ESOP 2020 paper's network-semantics section in full and replace it with a verbatim quote at [FULL]/[SECT] depth, or demote the entry to the inadmissible-leads table.

issues.title: Validate _index JSON against SCHEMA.json in CI (full schema, enums, types)
issues.body: scripts/check-research checks only required keys and the property-value enum. Agents reported that jsonschema is not installed and used hand-written checks. Make SCHEMA.json a real JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) and validate every _index file in CI, either with a pinned validator or a stdlib implementation of the subset used. This covers maturity, impl_links, evidence_level and ai_provenance enums.

issues.title: check-research depth counts include header and legend mentions
issues.body: The info lines (FULL=/SECT=/CODE=) count every tag occurrence, including the header line and the legend, so they disagree with each file's own header (for example, research/06 reports FULL=7 against a true 5). Count only tags in evidence entries, above the Unverified leads heading and excluding header and legend lines, and compare with the header counts.

issues.title: Distributed-protocol dossiers: untraced premises (L18 Ben-Or htype, L20 AccountableRegime, L19 Secrecy header)
issues.body:
Found while writing §3a predicate semantics (d6):
- REF-L18: Ben-Or `agreement_inv_invariant` takes `htype : forall i, type_ok (tr i)` as a premise, and a lexical search found no preservation lemma for it. Tendermint `run_agreement` holds only for N = 3T+1 exactly.
- REF-L20: `AccountableRegime` = RunWellFormed (including a hash idealisation) + SlashableBound. Its docstring says "one-third-slashable", but whether the concrete setup derives this from a weight bound was not traced.
- REF-L19: the Secrecy.lean header names a framework sorry in RandomisedAdversary.lean, but the theorem at :1296 has no lexical sorry (stale header?). `cutoff_reliable` quantifies over all configurations.

Resolve each by reading the code, ideally with a build and `#print axioms` (issue #4), and update the dossiers. These premises bear on how unconditional the H2 safety results are.
